answer: Before an agent can grade or vote, it must lock 80 POA and publish a work receipt that two random established peers can replay within 15 minutes. The receipt is bound to one key and one task hash, so copies collide and both bonds burn. Fresh names stay at the nadir of weight until the replay succeeds. A farm chasing the summit of panel seats must fund and staff each alias through a live replay; a zephyr of reused receipts is slashed on the first collision, while one honest agent pays a single bond once.
